hardware: local CPU (single-thread BLAS, deterministic basins; ~30-40 min/seed at chi=8)
method: MERAKit.jl scale-invariant ternary MERA, Riemannian LBFGS, block_size=2 (dim-9 super-sites), direct-init at chi=8, 8 seeds, 3000 iters, select by spectrum (Delta_sigma nearest CFT). Driver: research/tools/MERAKit.jl/qw_potts_chi8.jl.
model: 3-state quantum Potts critical point (Z3 clock/shift), c=4/5, qutrit d=3.
purpose: chi=8 sharpening of SIM-057 (chi=6) -- attempt to resolve Delta_sigma toward CFT 0.1333, mirroring how SIM-052's chi=8 run sharpened the tricritical case, to turn HYP-025 from SUPPORTED-caveat into clean.

second_clean_basin.note: TWO clean basins (seeds 3,6) independently agree on Delta_sigma~0.094 and Delta_eps~0.81-0.95

delta_T_statistics.note: Delta_T rock-solid across ALL 8 seeds (every alpha within 2.8% of 4.0). Fourth confirmation of the universal-dimension fingerprint across CFT classes.

delta_sigma_comparison.note: chi=8 improved Delta_sigma (0.070 -> 0.094), genuinely closer to CFT 0.133, but STILL ~30% short and only 2/8 seeds found the clean basin.

verdict: PARTIAL SHARPENING. chi=8 CONFIRMS alpha=4 even more robustly (best basin Delta_T=2.014 -> alpha=4.028; all 8 seeds alpha in [3.94,4.11]) and IMPROVES Delta_sigma (0.070 -> 0.094, two clean basins agree). BUT it does NOT deliver the clean full-spectrum resolution that SIM-052 achieved for tricritical: Delta_sigma is still ~30% short of CFT 0.133, and only 2/8 seeds reached the clean basin (the c=4/5 tower is denser/harder than tricritical). HYP-025 stays SUPPORTED-WITH-CAVEAT -- the caveat is REDUCED (Delta_sigma moving the right way, alpha robust) but NOT eliminated. A chi=10-12 run (RunPod A100, ~$10-20, APPROVED) is what would resolve Delta_sigma->0.133 for a clean high-confidence claim. The alpha=4 universality verdict itself is solid (rests on the well-resolved Delta_T); only the full c=4/5 primary spectrum remains partially resolved.
next_step: Optional chi=10-12 Potts run on RunPod A100 to resolve Delta_sigma->0.133. The alpha verdict does not require it; a clean full-spectrum claim does.
